reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with Wahoo
reauth_confirm.description: Your Wahoo authorization has expired or was revoked. Sign in again to continue syncing workouts.

abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Please follow the documentation to set up Application Credentials.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. Configure an external URL for Home Assistant or enable My Home Assistant.
abort.oauth_error: Received invalid token data from Wahoo.
abort.oauth_failed: Error retrieving access token from Wahoo.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timeout while retrieving the access token.

render_workout.name: Render workout track
render_workout.description: Fetch a Wahoo workout by id and render its FIT file to a GeoJSON track under the HA config www/hawahooligan/ directory.

workout_id.name: Workout ID
workout_id.description: Numeric Wahoo workout id (visible in the Wahoo web app URL).

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required when more than one Wahoo account is configured.

force.name: Force re-render
force.description: Re-download the FIT and overwrite the existing GeoJSON even if a file for this workout id already exists.

select_workout.name: Select workout
select_workout.description: Pin the headline sensors and the map viewer to a specific workout id so the entire dashboard follows the chosen ride. Pass 'latest' to release the pin.

workout_id.name: Workout ID
workout_id.description: Numeric Wahoo workout id, or the literal 'latest' to follow the newest workout.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required when more than one Wahoo account is configured.

full_backfill.name: Full-history backfill
full_backfill.description: Paginate through the user's entire Wahoo history and feed the lifetime totals. Rate-limit aware. Fires the hawahooligan_full_backfill_progress event after each page.

with_tracks.name: Also render tracks
with_tracks.description: Also download and render the FIT file for each outdoor workout. Adds disk usage but no extra API quota.

max_pages.name: Max pages
max_pages.description: Safety guard — stop after this many pages.

window_seconds.name: Window seconds
window_seconds.description: Rolling-window length in seconds. Wahoo's window is 300 s.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required when more than one Wahoo account is configured.

cleanup_geojson.name: Cleanup cached tracks
cleanup_geojson.description: Prune cached GeoJSON track files older than max_age_days from www/hawahooligan/. The cache grows with backfills and render_workout calls; run from a nightly automation to cap disk usage.

max_age_days.name: Max age (days)
max_age_days.description: Files older than this threshold are removed. Default 180 covers two riding seasons.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required when more than one Wahoo account is configured.

refresh_power_zones.name: Refresh FTP / power zones
refresh_power_zones.description: Force an immediate refresh of the FTP, Critical Power, and zone-threshold sensors instead of waiting for the regular 24-hour cycle. Fire-and-forget — runs in the background and updates the sensors when Wahoo responds.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Only required when more than one Wahoo account is configured.
